description: Implementation of Azure Blob Cache with methods for setting, getting, and managing cache asynchronously and synchronously, including connection handling and cache flushing.

classes.name: AzureBlobCache
classes.description: A cache class that interacts with Azure Blob Storage for storing and retrieving cache data, supporting both sync and async operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes AzureBlobCache with account URL and container, setting up both sync and async container clients.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Serializes and uploads a cache item to Azure Blob Storage synchronously.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Serializes and uploads a cache item to Azure Blob Storage asynchronously.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Downloads and deserializes a cache item from Azure Blob Storage synchronously.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Downloads and deserializes a cache item from Azure Blob Storage asynchronously.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Deletes all blobs in the container, clearing the cache.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the container clients, cleaning up connections.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Sets multiple cache items asynchronously in parallel.
